summary: No actionable P1/P2 found in reviewed current source. Compiled-browser acceptance remains required and is not claimed by this static review.

evidence: public-preferences.ts:13 fixed String.raw literal has no request, DTO, cookie, translation, href or nonce interpolation; exact literal parses as JavaScript without execution.
Cookie reads only drive a three-value parser; cookie writes only receive fixed theme/locale enums. Invalid values cannot add attributes, executable code or cookie directives.
public-response.tsx Head script and post-root sync script use the same nonce as publicSecurityHeaders; existing catalog/bootstrap escaping remains unchanged.
New document scripts are outside the hydrated app root, and fixed code contains no literal closing script marker. Public chat uses ReactMarkdown without rehypeRaw.
Captured input requires a native HTMLSelectElement carrying an exact marker inside current #root. Unsupported controls, detached roots and unmarked input are ignored.
Locales are the same en/zh/ja/ko enum as public-location.tsx. Existing prefixed public page and model-detail regexes, backslash rejection and query/hash preservation agree with localizePublicHref.
Private routes, unsupported locale prefixes and malformed public paths return before NEXT_LOCALE write or navigation; destination is rooted /<allowed-locale>/..., preserving same-origin navigation.

This is a document-scoped public preference owner. main.tsx selects public SSR or Legacy at document startup; account/auth completion uses location.assign, so current production does not reuse this document owner for a Legacy root.
Absent readable cookie null is distinguished from denied read undefined. Denied reads do not reset the document memory theme to system.
Theme change stores the last observed readable cookie after attempted write; silently denied or throwing writes leave the current memory choice intact through subsequent sync/media/pageshow.

pageshow adopts a readable cookie only if its value differs from the last observation; external preference updates/removal can restore while unchanged denied-write cookies do not overwrite current memory.
Explicit light/dark remains explicit across OS media changes; system follows media.matches. Locale navigation proceeds even if the preference-cookie write throws.
PublicShell removes React onChange and useSyncExternalStore/effect theme ownership. Native selects use stable SSR defaults; React effect only syncs values and exposes/cleans readiness metadata.
Head initialization runs before CSS/main body; suffix synchronization runs after complete #root markup and before bootstrap/router/client entry scripts.

Local installed React19 prepareToHydrateHostInstance select branch validates props/registers invalid and does not reset selected options; uncontrolled select updates only reset options on multiple-state changes. This patch keeps multiple absent/stable.
No new component/provider is inserted into PublicApplication, router tree or app root; identifierPrefix remains cinatoken-public-. Document-composition useId test is retained.
Guarded singleton install owns one document change capture listener, one media listener and one pageshow listener; React does not add another preference change handler.
dispose is idempotent, removes all three listeners using the same callbacks/capture flag, and deletes the global only if it still refers to this instance; stale dispose cannot delete a later owner.
No pagehide disposal is performed, retaining the document controller across BFCache. pageshow restores readable shared cookies and re-syncs selectors/classes.
Root React unmount cleans readiness metadata but does not dispose the document owner; this matches the early-to-late document lifetime contract and current production full-navigation boundary.
